protocol:
1. Arrange the Invitrogen E-Gel EX cassette, E-Gel Power Snap instrument with the orange filter lid open, adjustable micropipette, pipette tips, labeled microcentrifuge tubes, and ice tray on the bench.

2. Keep the labeled microcentrifuge tubes chilled in the green ice tray during gel loading.

3. Attach a clean pipette tip from the tip rack to the adjustable micropipette.

4. Remove a labeled microcentrifuge tube from the ice tray and hold it upright.

5. Aspirate an aliquot of sample from the microcentrifuge tube with the micropipette.

6. Dispense the sample aliquot into one well of the E-Gel EX cassette.

7. Return the sample tube to the ice tray.

8. Replace the pipette tip with a clean tip before loading the next material.

9. Repeat sample aspiration and dispensing for the remaining labeled tubes, loading each aliquot into a separate well of the E-Gel EX cassette.

10. Aspirate an aliquot from the labeled tube in the white tube rack and dispense it into a separate well of the E-Gel EX cassette.

11. Place the loaded E-Gel EX cassette into the E-Gel Power Snap instrument.

12. Seat the cassette flat in the instrument bed using both gloved hands.

13. Close the orange filter lid on the E-Gel Power Snap instrument.

14. Start the electrophoresis run by pressing the E-Gel Power Snap touchscreen; the display shows a countdown timer.
